value.rationale: This is the first depth with two interacting branching levels in the established weighted radial binary-tree trace extension problem. The exact universal linear bound at the excluded total-variation endpoint has two structural changes, a unique nonmonotone worst-case weight, and a canonical optimizer whose children eventually coincide. The result is a natural complete finite benchmark, not merely a numeric test or arbitrary parameter substitution.
